title: G9: executors routed by expected completion cost per task class with a success floor, falling back to weight times score below the sample size
spec:
Depends on G1b (T-0265, token buckets per run and per goal). Today pool.pick_executor ranks enabled in-range executors by weight times scorecard score (live success rate or a bench prior). The analysis: aggregate success rates punish models given harder work; route by initial tokens + expected repair tokens + orchestration and review overhead per task class, with an acceptable success rate as a floor, and let local outcomes replace external priors.
Change:
1. Task class: constraints.task_class when the spec sets it (mechanical, unfamiliar, debugging, architectural, security), else inferred: security when any scope path matches [review].security_paths, architectural when complexity is 7 or more, debugging when the title starts with 'fix' or has fix_round_for, mechanical when complexity is 3 or less, unfamiliar otherwise. scorecard.task_class(task) exposes the rule.
2. scorecard.expected_cost(executor_id, task_class) from run rows: median total_tokens of that executor's execute runs of the class + P(fail or fix round) times median total_tokens of its fix-round runs (tasks with fix_round_for) + median review and spec_review tokens for tasks of the class; None when fewer than [models].min_samples (default 3) merged tasks of that class exist for the executor.
3. pool.pick_executor(role, complexity, scores, task=None): among enabled in-range executors with success rate at or above [models].success_floor (default 0.6) and an expected cost, pick the lowest expected cost; when no executor has enough samples, today's weight times score ranking applies unchanged. status() and `orchestrator scorecard --by executor` show expected cost per class when present.
4. pool.toml [models]: success_floor = 0.6, min_samples = 3, with comments; README Executors and routing paragraph updated.
Tests: tests/test_scorecard.py::test_task_class_inference, ::test_expected_cost_needs_samples, ::test_expected_cost_includes_repairs; tests/test_pool.py::test_pick_by_expected_cost_with_floor, ::test_pick_falls_back_without_samples.
acceptance: pool.toml [models] documents success_floor and min_samples; README updated
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
